title: Four allowlisted operations targets
summary: Wire gateway authenticates and authorizes before backend TN3270 or HTTPS/WebSocket connections. It does not become a generic proxy.
invariants: Exactly two TN3270 targets: ed209zz and ed209z.
Exactly two web targets: ed209cray and ed209tops, never ed209dec.
Authorization checked before opening target sockets and at each effectful operation.
No arbitrary target URL/port, SSRF, X-Forwarded-For source authority or proxy bypass.
Session teardown upon logout and truthful NOT_RUN status for unknown ports/hosts.
